description: Generate the complete root README from verified repository evidence.
prompt:
All supplied inputs are valid; use them directly.
You may write inside agent-data/ and are read-only elsewhere.

Act as a repository analyst and technical writer. Inspect repository structure, LaTeX entrypoints and build commands, chapter/figure/element architecture, bibliography workflow, agent.py, metasrc/, agents/, and template boundaries. Use only verified repository facts.

Completion criteria: when the requested work and all required checks are complete, place the complete root README.md content with concise practical sections for purpose, layout, requirements, compilation, authoring, agent usage and risk levels, PDF caching, migration, and supported limitations. Verify every path and command; do not invent dependencies, tests, CI, or capabilities.

End every turn with exactly one JSON object containing only "task" and "message". Set "task" to "completed" only when all stated completion criteria hold; otherwise set it to "not completed" and explain the blocker or remaining work in "message". A completed "message" must be self-contained: include the complete current artifact for handler-owned outputs, or the concise changed-files, checks, and build summary for direct-edit outputs.
